items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Has 304 yards in last three games
items.body_text: Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Season-high 243 yards but two INTs
items.body_text: Mayfield completed 18 of 32 passes for 243 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears. He also rushed once for no gain and ran in a two-point conversion. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Three catches in return
items.body_text: Egbuka (foot) caught three of five targets for 38 yards and added a one-yard run in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Colston Loveland: Sets up winning FG with 38-yard grab
items.body_text: Loveland caught four of six targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rome Odunze: Notches first TD in Week 9 win
items.body_text: Odunze caught four of seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
